correctness.rationale: Direct substitution in the published reduced Riccati map gives the normalized disk automorphism. Its exact defect identity yields a telescoping logarithmic recursion. The independent uniform phase makes the next angular coordinate Haar and makes log|1+s w_n| a bounded martingale difference after at most a two-step exceptional transient. Jensen's circle identity gives zero conditional mean, and the martingale strong law proves the exponent. The standalone replay checks all finite identities and representative slopes.
